rule: Stand-ins for the cell's missing clutter and furniture (lane L17, planner brief 2026-09-28): each missing piece is drawn by a published vanilla or King of the Murkmire piece of the same object and near size, read from the kit manifests; a piece with no same-object stand-in stays a listed gap.
